title: feat(nperpin): perpnn y-probe own-lock-in exist-opposite: reverse fails, face fails
science: Own-lock-in on perpnn 1-seed y-probes: every letter in all four S^+ sets is positive, so both bits fail and named-sign lettering is degenerate (the note observes {+,-} cannot even distinguish +e1 from +e2 here). Documents the all-positive orientation of the 1-seed cone that is the root cause of #7147's permanent reverse-fail.
